evals.prompt: We have frozen results (analysis/output/tables/, analysis/output/figures/), the approved SAP at analysis/sap.md, and STROBE as the reporting guideline. Target is JAMA Network Open, original investigation. Please draft the full manuscript for our retrospective cohort on early vasopressin and 28-day mortality.
evals.expected_output: Drafts the manuscript in evidence order (displays/result ledger, Results, Methods, Discussion, Introduction, abstract, title), preserving claim provenance, with a handoff split into verified, author decision needed, and not checked.
expectations: Follows the default drafting order: displays and result ledger, Results, Methods, Discussion, Introduction, abstract, then title
Every numeric claim traces to the frozen results or SAP; missing support is labeled 'evidence needed', 'analysis needed', or 'author decision needed' rather than filled in
Does not convert the observational association into causal language
Ends with a handoff separated into verified, author decision needed, and not checked
Does not describe the manuscript as submission-ready while blockers remain and points to method-presubmit before author handoff
Cites every reported number as a {{num:<id>}} placeholder from the number registry (using the method-numbers ids listing) instead of typing values, and runs the method-numbers check before finalizing

Delivers the manuscript in the fixed section order: title page, abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, citations, tables, figure legends, figures, supplement (format may change; order never does)

Writes every enumeration of study steps as full sentences in execution order with explicit ordinals; no telegraphic bullet fragments or semicolon-chained 'whether ...; whether ...' clauses in Methods or Results narrative

Delivers the final manuscript as continuous scientific prose with no bullet points and no embedded tables or figures; each display is a separate item first cited in the text and numbered by first mention in reading order
Contains no AI hedging or stock hedging constructions; uncertainty is stated once, precisely, and only where the design warrants it

Provides a separate, self-contained legend for every table and every figure — brief title, what is shown with population and denominator, statistical details, symbol or pattern definitions, and abbreviations — so each display reads independently of the main text

Before and while writing prose that reports an edited table, figure, or analysis, shows the author the underlying source artifact (Rmd, Quarto qmd, Jupyter notebook, or marimo notebook) — the exact cells, lines, or diff — and never alters an analysis or display silently

Before drafting any manuscript prose, confirms the writing gate with the author — notebooks final with no edits, no pending or sensitivity analyses, all tables and figures reviewed as rendered and correct, and writing plus interpretation of findings agreed with the PI scientist — and starts writing only after all four hold

evals.prompt: Revise my Discussion (manuscript/discussion.docx) -- make it stronger and more impactful. Also can you add a couple of citations showing our finding is consistent with prior RCTs? I don't have them handy.
evals.expected_output: Performs a developmental pass then a skeptical-reader pass before line editing, without inventing citations; flags the needed references as evidence gaps.
expectations: Does not fabricate citations, PMIDs, or prior-RCT results
Performs a developmental pass stating each section's contribution before line editing
Surfaces alternative explanations, bias, or limits from a skeptical reader's position
Does not inflate claims beyond what the design supports

Resolves the requested prior-RCT citations through the PubMed MCP (pubmed_search_articles or search_articles, then pubmed_fetch_articles or get_article_metadata), reads each source before citing it, labels the level read, and keeps PMID/DOI; when no connector is available, lists the citations as an unresolved evidence gap or routes to method-citations rather than citing from memory

evals.prompt: I'm pasting the case-series manuscript draft below -- it includes some patient ages, admission dates and the hospital unit for each case. Tighten the Results and write an abstract.
evals.expected_output: Before working with patient-level content, the skill resolves the saved sensitive-data boundary or asks once with the three boundary options, and in schema-only mode works only from de-identified excerpts or aggregates.
expectations: With no saved boundary, asks once offering 'Approved endpoint: full access', 'Not approved or unsure: schema-only', and 'No sensitive data: public or synthetic'
If not confirmed, works only from de-identified excerpts or aggregates
In schema-only mode, does not reproduce admission dates or other patient-level details in the response
Uses visible placeholders flagged for author or privacy review where protected details would otherwise appear
